name: VYRON Question Taxonomy & Intent Classification Matrix
description: Deterministic 16-class question taxonomy with multi-label support, entity resolution, risk rating, and lifecycle bindings.

questionTypes.label: Factual Retrieval
questionTypes.description: Direct inquiry regarding invariant system properties, definitions, RFCs, or repository metadata.

questionTypes.label: Conceptual & System Explanation
questionTypes.description: Inquiry seeking conceptual clarity, architectural rationales, or component interaction walkthroughs.

questionTypes.label: Defect & Anomaly Diagnostics
questionTypes.description: Incident diagnosis, bug isolation, stack trace inspection, or root-cause identification.

questionTypes.label: Architecture & Schema Design
questionTypes.description: Architectural modeling, database schema synthesis, interface design, or pattern selection.

questionTypes.label: Code & Artifact Synthesis
questionTypes.description: Code generation, endpoint implementation, test scaffolding, or concrete artifact creation.

questionTypes.label: Refactoring & Migration
questionTypes.description: Code translation, protocol migration, schema mutation, or formatting normalization.

questionTypes.label: Static AST & Metric Analysis
questionTypes.description: Deep analysis of AST call graphs, cyclomatic complexity, architectural drift, or telemetry.

questionTypes.label: Trade-off & Option Comparison
questionTypes.description: Comparative evaluation of two or more libraries, architectural patterns, or PR diffs.

questionTypes.label: Engineering Roadmap & Strategy
questionTypes.description: Formulating execution milestones, stage sequences, dependency DAGs, or migration roadmaps.

questionTypes.label: Deterministic Formula & Metric Math
questionTypes.description: Computation of DORA metrics, risk scores, p99 latency, cost projections, or formulas.

questionTypes.label: Multimodal & Visual Intelligence
questionTypes.description: Visual diagram interpretation, UI screenshot critique, canvas layout, or OCR.

questionTypes.label: Resource & Document Discovery
questionTypes.description: External documentation retrieval, research paper digest, or connector catalog lookup.

questionTypes.label: Governed Control Plane Execution
questionTypes.description: Executing tool mutations, deployments, connector bindings, or stage promotions.

questionTypes.label: Code & Contract Verification
questionTypes.description: Validating PR changes, verifying contract conformance, security auditing, or checks.

questionTypes.label: Task & Stage Progression
questionTypes.description: Advancing to next stage in the 12-stage lifecycle or resuming a paused engineering mission.

questionTypes.label: Degraded Fallback / Unresolved
questionTypes.description: Underspecified query requiring clarification before consequential actions.
